parsed.answer: The evidence explicitly identifies pyridostatin (PDS) as a G4-stabilizing compound and notes that G-quadruplex-forming genomic sequences include telomeres, with PDS treatment increasing telomere fragility. This directly supports the claim that pyridostatin stabilizes the G-quadruplex in the telomeric region. The telomere-specific effect is inferred from PDS increasing telomere fragility and reducing replication efficiency of G-rich telomeric repeats.
